instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show me what is filling my Mac's disk." It reads the row with do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools, method tools:list, input {tool: "tool:github:govijr-fix-storage"}.

2. It checks that git, Node.js and macOS are on your computer, and if fix-storage is missing it runs the get_it steps: git clone https://github.com/govijr/fix-storage.git ; cd fix-storage ; npm install.
3. It runs the row's command: npm start
4. Read what it shows you. The site you asked through runs none of this; it all happens on your own computer.
